title: 第9章 一个月的收获第10章 陈家有祖名长安
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 第9章一个月的收获“老祖！”
“我……我竟然真的提升到了真气境一重？”
“这，这简直太不可思议了！”
一个月的时间，陈云轩一直跟在陈长安的身边修炼。
陈长安提供资源，陈云轩只需要不停地修炼就好。
陈云轩原本以为，一个月的时间，能够让他从聚灵境七重提升到凝元境五重，便已经是极快的速度。
可没想到，竟然直接一举突破到了真气境一重，这已经相当于一个月之前，陈家家主陈正元的修为了。
对于陈云轩而言，这一个月如同梦境一般，而且是他做过最好的美梦。
看到陈云轩这激动的模样，陈长安十分理解，穷人乍富吗，都激动！
“云轩，你的天资其实并不是很差。”
“只不过，当初的陈家底蕴不足，加上这大周国，又地处偏僻，属于贫瘠之地。”
“否则的话，你不会十六岁却只有聚灵境七重的修为。”
“你以为那些超级天才，除了自身拥有无敌的天赋之外，还靠的是什么？”
“告诉你，底蕴，他们所拥有的修炼资源，远超常人想象。”
“这个世界很大，大周国不过是弹丸之地不值一提。”
“若真的想要闯出一番名堂，云轩，你要走出去看看。”陈长安淡笑着说道。
走出去看看？
听闻此话，陈云轩心中也是期待不已，是啊，只有走出这弹丸之地，或许才会拥有一片新天地。
“如果你从小生活在真正灵气充沛的地方，又有修炼资源的话。”
“你如今十六岁的年龄，又怎么可能只会是真气境一重。”
“超凡境也不是不可能！”
陈长安虽然一直随着师父隐居，但也时不时的经常偷跑出去玩。
外面的事情并不是特别了解，但真正的天之骄子，倒也是认识过几位。
那些人，无一不是超级天才，年纪轻轻修为强大，都是一代天骄！
“老祖……您的意思是，真的有人十六岁就能够达到超凡境的修为吗？”
陈云轩一脸震惊的表情，这是他接触不到，也完全无法想象的事情。
十六岁的超凡境，这修炼速度未免也太快了一些吧？
“所以，你要出去走走看，长长见识。”
“井底之蛙，怎知天有多高，天有多大？”陈长安笑着说道。
“老祖教训的是。”
陈云轩如今更加向往外面的世界，一颗种子，已经在心中种下。
陈长安之所以这么开导陈云轩，一方面是希望他走出去增长一些阅历，这对他只有好处没有坏处。
另外一方面，陈长安也有自己的想法。
如今胎珠下落不明，天下之大，靠他一个人全部找回来，恐怕也并不是那么容易。
但若是有人帮忙，效率会提升不少。
陈云轩出去之后，可以帮助自己打听这方面的消息。
就在两人交谈之时，陈正元来到了陈长安居住的庭院。
陈正元先是看了一眼陈云轩，眼神之中满是骄傲和自豪。
如今自己的儿子跟随老祖修炼，实力果然是突飞猛进，日后前途不可限量！
“见过老祖！”
“老祖，我们陈家在燕归城的眼线带来消息，徐宁两家似乎又所动作。”
“我怀疑，他们是奔着咱们陈家而来。”陈正元皱着眉头说道。
燕归城另外两个家族，徐家和宁家？
“来就来吧。”

Chapter 9 One Month’s Harvest “Ancestor!”
"I...I actually ascended to the first level of the True Qi Realm?"
"This, this is incredible!"
For a month, Chen Yunxuan has been practicing beside Chen Changan.
Chen Changan provides resources, and Chen Yunxuan just needs to keep practicing.
Chen Yunxuan originally thought that one month would be an extremely fast speed for him to advance from the seventh level of the Spirit Gathering Realm to the fifth level of the Condensing Yuan Realm.
Unexpectedly, he actually broke through to the first level of the True Qi Realm in one fell swoop. This was equivalent to the cultivation level of Chen Zhengyuan, the head of the Chen family, a month ago.
For Chen Yunxuan, this month was like a dream, and it was the best dream he had ever had.
Seeing Chen Yunxuan's excited look, Chen Changan understood very well. Even if the poor suddenly become rich, they are all excited!
"Yunxuan, your talent is actually not very bad."
"It's just that the Chen family didn't have enough foundation at the time, and the Zhou Kingdom was located in a remote and barren land."
"Otherwise, you wouldn't be sixteen years old but only have the cultivation level of the seventh level of the Spirit Gathering Realm."
"What do you think those super geniuses rely on besides their own invincible talent?"
"Let me tell you, the cultivation resources they possess are far beyond ordinary people's imagination."
"This world is very big, and the Great Zhou Kingdom is just a small place and not worth mentioning."
"If you really want to make a name for yourself, Yun Xuan, you have to go out and have a look." Chen Changan said with a faint smile.
Go outside and take a look?
After hearing this, Chen Yunxuan was also looking forward to it. Yes, only by getting out of this small place, maybe he will have a new world.
"If you have lived in a place with real spiritual energy since childhood and have the resources for cultivation."
"How can you be sixteen years old now and only be at the first level of the True Qi Realm?"
"The transcendent realm is not impossible!"
Although Chen Changan has been living in seclusion with his master, he often sneaks out to play from time to time.
I don’t know much about the outside world, but I have met a few of the true pride of heaven.
Those people are all super geniuses. They are young and powerful in cultivation. They are all geniuses of the generation!
"Ancestor... do you mean that there are really people who can reach the extraordinary realm at the age of sixteen?"
Chen Yunxuan had a shocked expression on his face. This was something that was beyond his reach and completely unimaginable.
At the age of sixteen, in the extraordinary realm, this cultivation speed is too fast, right?
"So, you have to go out and take a look and learn a lot."
"How can a frog at the bottom of a well know how high and how big the sky is?" Chen Changan said with a smile.
"That's what our ancestor taught us."
Chen Yunxuan now yearns for the outside world even more, and a seed has been planted in his heart.
The reason why Chen Changan enlightened Chen Yunxuan in this way was that he wanted him to go out and gain some experience, which would only be good for him and not harmful.
On the other hand, Chen Changan also has his own ideas.
Nowadays, the whereabouts of the fetal beads are unknown. The world is so big that it may not be that easy for him to find them all by himself.
But if someone helps, the efficiency will be improved a lot.
After Chen Yunxuan goes out, he can help him inquire about this information.
While the two were talking, Chen Zhengyuan came to the courtyard where Chen Changan lived.
Chen Zhengyuan first glanced at Chen Yunxuan, his eyes full of pride and pride.
Now that his son is practicing with his ancestor, his strength has really improved by leaps and bounds, and his future will be limitless!
"I've met my ancestor!"
"Ancestor, our Chen family's spy in Yangui City has brought news that the Xu Ning family seems to be taking action again."
"I suspect that they are coming to our Chen family." Chen Zhengyuan said with a frown.
The other two families in Yangui City, the Xu family and the Ning family?
"Come on."
